We need to build BPMN diagram from description. Steps: parse description, identify actors, activities, decisions, parallel.

Actors: Blizzard (organisation) likely system? Text mentions "you" (user) and possibly "system". Probably two lanes: "Player" and "System". But could also include "Account System". We'll decide: Lane "Player" for user activities; Lane "System" for system checks.

Activities in order:

1. Check whether you have a Battle.net account. (System? Or decision by user?) It's a check, could be system activity: "Check for Battle.net account".
2. If not have one, enter account information and click confirmation link. So two tasks: "Enter account information", "Click confirmation link". Could be in Player lane.
3. After you have account, check if you have active WoW subscription. System check.
4. If not, select payment method. (Player selects)
5. If credit card, enter credit card information. (Player)
6. If bank account, enter IBAN and BIC numbers. (Player)
7. After that (i.e., after subscription active), log into the game and select realm, race, class. (Player task: "Log into game and select realm, race and class")
8. Until now, you should have come up with some good names. (Probably done earlier, but we can model as a task "Come up with character names" maybe in parallel with earlier steps? Actually description says "While you are setting up your account, you can already come up with good character names." So parallel: name generation can happen in parallel with account setup steps. So we need a parallel split at start? The start event leads to parallel gateway: one branch for account setup, another for naming.

Account setup branch includes steps 1-7.

Naming branch: "Enter character names one by one until a name is still available." So task "Enter character name". Then decision: "Is name available?" If not, loop back to "Enter character name". If yes, proceed to "Get confirmation and character selfies". Then maybe also "When expansion is released you get another message" (maybe after confirmation). That's another task "Receive expansion release message". This likely after confirmation.

Thus after name available and confirmation, we might end process but also have final message. Could be sequential: task "Get confirmation and character selfies", then task "Receive expansion release message". Then end.

Also there is parallel with account setup; after both branches finish, we need to join before ending? Usually both branches converge before end. So after account setup (log in etc) and naming (confirmation, message) we need a parallel join, then end.

Check for parallel: At start we create parallel gateway splitting into two: "Account setup path" and "Name generation path". Then after each finishes we join with parallel gateway then end.

We need exclusive gateways for decisions: checking Battle.net account (yes/no), checking subscription (yes/no), payment method (credit card vs bank account), name availability (yes/no). Use exclusive gateways.

Now assign lane: All player tasks go in Player lane; system checks in System lane. For decisions we can place in lane of who decides? Usually system gateway for check of account, but we can put gateway in System lane.

List tasks and IDs:

Start event: id="start"

Parallel split gateway id="split" (parallelGateway)

Account branch:

- System task: "Check for Battle.net account" id="checkAccount"
- Exclusive gateway "Account exists?" id="gwAccount"
- No branch: Player tasks "Enter account information" id="enterInfo", "Click confirmation link" id="clickLink", then back to checkAccount? Actually after creating account, you have account, so flow continues to next step. So after clickLink, we can go to "Check for Battle.net account" again? Simpler: after clickLink go to checkAccount again, then yes path. Or directly to next step "Check WoW subscription". I'll just go to next step.

- Yes branch: System task "Check active WoW subscription" id="checkSubscription"
- Exclusive gateway "Subscription active?" id="gwSub"
- No branch: Player task "Select payment method" id="selectPayment"
- Exclusive gateway "Payment method?" id="gwPayment"
   - Credit card branch: Player task "Enter credit card information" id="enterCC"
   - Bank account branch: Player task "Enter IBAN and BIC numbers" id="enterBank"
- Both converge to a parallel join maybe? Actually after payment info, then subscription becomes active then proceed. Use exclusive gateway merge? simpler: after each payment branch, flow to "Check active WoW subscription" again or directly to next task. Let's after each payment entry go to "Check active WoW subscription". So we can route both to same node id="checkSubscription". But need to ensure subscription is active after payment; we could skip re-check and just go to next task.

- After subscription active (yes), Player task "Log into game and select realm, race and class" id="selectCharacter"

- Then branch ends (go to join gateway)

Name branch:

- Player task "Come up with character names" id="comeupNames" (could be before loop)
- Loop: Task "Enter character name" id="enterName"
- Exclusive gateway "Name available?" id="gwName"
   - No: flow back to "Enter character name"
   - Yes: Task "Get confirmation and character selfies" id="confirm"
   - Then task "Receive expansion release message" id="expMsg"
   - Then go to join gateway

After both branches, parallel join gateway id="join"

End event id="end"

Now we need to ensure all flow nodes are listed in lanes. Lanes: Player lane includes tasks: enterInfo, clickLink, selectPayment, enterCC, enterBank, selectCharacter, comeupNames, enterName, confirm, expMsg. System lane includes: checkAccount, checkSubscription, maybe some decision gateways (gwAccount, gwSub, gwPayment, gwName). Gateways could be in System or Player lanes; but we need each flow node listed exactly in one lane. We'll put decision gateways in System lane maybe for checks, but payment method decision could be Player. Simpler: Put all gateways in System lane (except payment method? Could be decision by player). Let's assign:

System lane: checkAccount, gwAccount, checkSubscription, gwSub, gwPayment, gwName.

Player lane: all tasks and parallel gateways maybe? Parallel gateways could be in System lane? Not crucial. We'll assign both parallel gateways (split and join) to System lane.

Now construct BPMN XML accordingly.

We must ensure ids unique, sequence flows appropriate.

Let's draft XML.

We need to call check_bpmn after building to catch errors but we can't run locally. We'll try to be correct.

IDs and ordering: place laneSet first, then flow nodes, then sequence flows.

Flow nodes order: startEvent, parallelGateway split, all tasks, gateways, endEvent.

Sequence flows must connect.

Define flow:

f1: start -> split

From split outgoing: to checkAccount (account path) and comeupNames (name path). So need two outgoing flows from split: f2 to checkAccount, f3 to comeupNames.

Account path:

f2: split -> checkAccount

f4: checkAccount -> gwAccount

gwAccount decision: if yes (has account) go to checkSubscription, if no go to enterInfo.

We can name flows "yes" and "no". So

f5: gwAccount (yes) -> checkSubscription

f6: gwAccount (no) -> enterInfo

After enterInfo -> clickLink (f7)

clickLink -> checkAccount (again) maybe but could go to checkSubscription directly. To simplify, after clickLink go to checkAccount again (f8) which will loop, eventually go yes path. This adds loop.

Now after checkSubscription:

f5 already to checkSubscription. Then gwSub decision:

f9: gwSub (yes) -> selectCharacter

f10: gwSub (no) -> selectPayment

selectPayment -> gwPayment decision

f11: gwPayment (credit card) -> enterCC

f12: gwPayment (bank) -> enterBank

After either payment entry, go to checkSubscription again (f13 from enterCC -> checkSubscription, f14 from enterBank -> checkSubscription). Or could go directly to selectCharacter but keep loop.

After selectCharacter -> (account branch end) go to join gateway (f15).

Now name branch:

comeupNames -> enterName (f16). Maybe we could skip comeupNames and directly to enterName, but keep.

enterName -> gwName (f17)

gwName (yes) -> confirm (f18)

gwName (no) -> loop back to enterName (f19)

confirm -> expMsg (f20)

expMsg -> join (f21)

Also perhaps after confirm, also could have join directly? but we need expMsg then join.

Now join gateway receives two incoming: from selectCharacter (f15) and from expMsg (f21).

After join -> end event (f22).

Now define elements:

Start event id="start" name="Start"

Parallel split gateway id="split" (parallelGateway)

Parallel join gateway id="join" (parallelGateway)

Tasks: ids as listed.

Gateways: exclusiveGateway id with name attr.

Define sequence flows with ids.

Make sure each flow node listed in flowNodeRef in lane.

Now produce XML.
